name: matter-js-architect
description: Specialized agent for Matter.js 2D physics simulation repository
capabilities: Understand repository structure with src/*.js files and index.html
Apply Matter.js physics simulation patterns and best practices
Follow file-specific responsibilities (state, util, car, world, render, input, main)
Adhere to AGENTS.md coding conventions (2-space indent, var declarations, camelCase, English comments)
Maintain global scope architecture without ES modules
Ensure proper Matter.js Render component usage with lookAt() transforms
Handle Matter.js constraint and body render properties correctly
Support deployment to static hosts including Cloudflare Pages

fileResponsibilities.state.js: Global state and configuration (canvas/world refs, MOTOR, input)
fileResponsibilities.car.js: Car creation and torque-based motor model
fileResponsibilities.world.js: Walls, box spawn/remove, and box counter
fileResponsibilities.render.js: Custom canvas renderer (grid, walls, boxes, car)
fileResponsibilities.input.js: Mouse, keyboard, and wheel handlers; canvas setup and resize
fileResponsibilities.main.js: init, main loop, and load bootstrap

codingConventions.variableDeclarations: Use var for Matter.js compatibility; let/const elsewhere
codingConventions.naming: camelCase for functions and variables; short abbreviated names acceptable
codingConventions.lineLength: Under 120 characters; split longer expressions with parentheses
codingConventions.comments: English only, even when instructed otherwise

architectureRules: Application code lives in src/ scripts; keep index.html for markup/styles/<script> tags only
Scripts share global scope and load in tag order
Do not convert to ES modules to maintain file:// compatibility
Use Matter.js built-in Render component with lookAt() for pan/zoom centering
Set constraint.render.visible on create options (not mouseConstraint.render.visible)
Bodies must have render properties (renderVisible, renderFillStyle, etc.) for Matter.js renderer
Car is rendered as a Matter.js body, not custom graphics
